title: Philip in Samaria, Simon the Sorcerer, The Ethiopian Eunuch

questions.question: After Stephen's death, a great persecution arose against the Jerusalem church. Everyone was scattered except whom?
options: The apostles
The seven deacons
The three thousand baptized at Pentecost
The women who had followed Jesus from Galilee
questions.explanation: Acts 8:1 (ESV): "And there arose on that day a great persecution against the church in Jerusalem, and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles."

questions.question: Saul was ravaging the church. What was he doing?
options: Entering house after house, dragging off men and women and committing them to prison
Burning the synagogues where believers gathered
Bringing false charges before Pilate against the disciples
Organizing synagogue beatings across all Judea and Galilee
questions.correctAnswer: Entering house after house, dragging off men and women and committing them to prison
questions.explanation: Acts 8:3 (ESV): "But Saul was ravaging the church, and entering house after house, he dragged off men and women and committed them to prison."

questions.question: Philip went down to a city in Samaria to proclaim Christ. What did the crowds pay attention to?
options: Both the signs Philip was doing and what he said
Primarily the miracles since few understood his preaching
His eloquence in explaining the Scriptures about Christ
The authority he spoke with, like one of the apostles
questions.correctAnswer: Both the signs Philip was doing and what he said
questions.explanation: Acts 8:6 (ESV): "And the crowds with one accord paid attention to what was being said by Philip, when they heard him and saw the signs that he did."

questions.question: Who was Simon in Samaria, and what had he practiced before Philip arrived?
options: A man who had previously practiced magic and amazed people, claiming to be someone great
A former Samaritan priest who had led people into idol worship
A Roman tax collector who had extorted the people of Samaria
A merchant who had sold false prophecies and charms for profit
questions.correctAnswer: A man who had previously practiced magic and amazed people, claiming to be someone great
questions.explanation: Acts 8:9 (ESV): "But there was a man named Simon, who had previously practiced magic in the city and amazed the nation of Samaria, saying that he himself was somebody great."

questions.question: Simon believed and was baptized. What specifically amazed him about Philip?
options: He was amazed at the signs and great miracles being performed
He marveled at Philip's knowledge of the Scriptures
He was astonished by the large numbers being baptized
He was amazed at how the sick were instantly healed
questions.correctAnswer: He was amazed at the signs and great miracles being performed
questions.explanation: Acts 8:13 (ESV): "Even Simon himself believed, and after being baptized he continued with Philip. And seeing signs and great miracles performed, he was amazed."

questions.question: Peter and John came from Jerusalem. When they prayed and laid hands on the Samaritans, what happened?
options: They received the Holy Spirit
They were healed of various diseases
They began to speak in new tongues
They fell to the ground and prophesied
questions.explanation: Acts 8:17 (ESV): "Then they laid their hands on them and they received the Holy Spirit."

questions.question: Simon offered the apostles money wanting to purchase the ability to give the Holy Spirit. How did Peter rebuke him?
options: "May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!"
"No man of God buys what God freely gives!"
"Your money is cursed because it was earned through sorcery."
"The Holy Spirit cannot be commanded by men, only received."
questions.correctAnswer: "May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!"
questions.explanation: Acts 8:20 (ESV): "But Peter said to him, 'May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!'"

questions.question: An angel of the Lord told Philip to go south to the road from Jerusalem to Gaza. Who did he encounter there?
options: An Ethiopian eunuch, a court official of the Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was in charge of her treasury
A Roman centurion seeking answers about the Jewish faith
A merchant from Arabia carrying incense for the Jerusalem temple
A traveling rabbi from Alexandria studying the Scriptures
questions.correctAnswer: An Ethiopian eunuch, a court official of the Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was in charge of her treasury
questions.explanation: Acts 8:27 (ESV): "And there was an Ethiopian, a eunuch, a court official of the Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was in charge of all her treasure."

questions.question: The Ethiopian eunuch was reading a passage from which book of the Bible?
options: Isaiah
Psalms
Daniel
Jeremiah
questions.explanation: Acts 8:28,30 (ESV): "...and he was reading the prophet Isaiah."

questions.question: The passage the eunuch was reading spoke of one who was "led as a sheep to the slaughter...like a lamb before its shearer is silent." He asked Philip: "About whom does the prophet say this, about himself or about someone else?"
options: Philip began with this Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus
Philip said honestly that this prophecy had multiple possible meanings
Philip explained that Isaiah was speaking of righteous Israel as a whole
Philip asked him first what he himself believed before answering
questions.correctAnswer: Philip began with this Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus
questions.explanation: Acts 8:35 (ESV): "Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning with this Scripture he told him the good news about Jesus."

questions.question: What did the eunuch ask when they came to some water along the road?
options: "See, here is water! What prevents me from being baptized?"
"Is this water from a holy spring suitable for baptism?"
"May Philip baptize me and is he authorized to do so?"
"What must I do before receiving baptism today?"
questions.correctAnswer: "See, here is water! What prevents me from being baptized?"
questions.explanation: Acts 8:36 (ESV): "And as they were going along the road they came to some water, and the eunuch said, 'See, here is water! What prevents me from being baptized?'"

questions.question: After Philip baptized the eunuch, what happened to Philip?
options: The Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away and he was found at Azotus
Philip remained with the eunuch until they reached Gaza
Philip was caught up into a vision and saw the throne of God
The Spirit led Philip back to Jerusalem to report to the apostles
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away and he was found at Azotus
questions.explanation: Acts 8:39-40 (ESV): "...the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more... But Philip found himself at Azotus..."

questions.question: After being baptized, what was the eunuch's response?
options: He went on his way rejoicing
He wept with tears of gratitude
He returned to Jerusalem to tell others
He praised God with a loud voice
questions.correctAnswer: He went on his way rejoicing
questions.explanation: Acts 8:39 (ESV): "...and the eunuch saw him no more, and went on his way rejoicing."

questions.question: After being transported to Azotus, what did Philip do as he traveled?
options: He preached the gospel to all the towns until he came to Caesarea
He returned to Jerusalem to report to Peter and John
He sailed to Cyprus to preach the word there
He founded a church in Azotus before moving on
questions.correctAnswer: He preached the gospel to all the towns until he came to Caesarea
questions.explanation: Acts 8:40 (ESV): "But Philip found himself at Azotus, and as he passed through he preached the gospel to all the towns until he came to Caesarea."

questions.question: Peter told Simon that his heart was not right before God and urged him to repent. He described Simon as being "in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of..."?
options: iniquity
wickedness
idolatry
darkness
questions.explanation: Acts 8:23 (ESV): "For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of iniquity."

key_verse_text: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning with this Scripture he told him the good news about Jesus.
